chunks.subject: AP English Literature
chunks.title: Literary Argument exemplar — Sample 3A, score 1-4-1 (6/6)
chunks.content: Literary Argument (Beloved) scored 6/6 (Thesis 1, Evidence & Commentary 4, Sophistication 1). Thesis (1): defensible interpretation that conflicts arise from withheld information and generational trauma of slavery. Evidence & Commentary (4): specific evidence for all claims ('That's not her mouth. That's not Sethe'; 'Thin love ain't love at all'; Paul D's trauma; the community's jealousy) with commentary consistently supporting the line of reasoning about withheld information causing suffering, addressing the work as a whole. Sophistication (1): explores tensions via the tobacco-tin metaphor (Paul D burying his experiences).

chunks.subject: AP English Literature
chunks.title: Literary Argument exemplar — Sample 3B, score 1-3-0 (4/6)
chunks.content: Literary Argument (Fences) scored 4/6 (Thesis 1, Evidence & Commentary 3, Sophistication 0). Thesis (1): defensible interpretation that Troy's secret affair becomes his family's downfall, showing family should come first. Evidence & Commentary (3): specific evidence for claims (leaving to see Alberta; Rose and Cory becoming distant) with commentary developing a line of reasoning — but the claim that 'family does not leave each other' is not fully integrated, so short of 4. Sophistication (0): Rose caring for the baby hints at complexity but is not explored.

chunks.subject: AP English Literature
chunks.title: Literary Argument exemplar — Sample 3C, score 1-2-0 (3/6)
chunks.content: Literary Argument (The Awakening) scored 3/6 (Thesis 1, Evidence & Commentary 2, Sophistication 0). Thesis (1): defensible claim that Edna's secret wish for independence creates detachment from other characters. Evidence & Commentary (2): some specific evidence ('caged bird'; the socially unacceptable secret) but paragraph 3 offers broad generalities ('the story could have been different had Edna simply voiced her concern') that support no claim, so no line of reasoning; commentary is repetitive. Sophistication (0): not demonstrated.
